item.title: We rewrote our Rust WASM Parser in TypeScript – and it got 3x Faster
item.description:
📝 We built the openui-lang parser in Rust and compiled it to WASM. The overhead was entirely in the boundary: copy string in, serialize result to JSON string, copy JSON string out, then V8 deserializes it back into a JS object. This isolates per-call parser cost.
🔗 Read more: https://www.openui.com/blog/rust-wasm-parser
